clue.text: Said of one in quiet acres, possibly?

definitions.text: Said of one in quiet acres, possibly?

indicators.note: possibly says the two words quiet acres may be rearranged into another phrase

explanation.surface: A remark made about someone lying in a peaceful country graveyard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' signals an anagram of QUIET ACRES. The whole clue is also the definition: the Latin prayer 'may he rest' is said over someone buried in a quiet churchyard.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin prayer for the dead, 'may he rest in peace', is spoken over someone buried in a churchyard.

clue.text: Regretted sounding blue

indicators.note: sounding says the word for regretted is heard, not spelt, giving a different word

parts.note: regretted means rued

explanation.surface: Feeling sad and saying so in a downcast way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Regretted' looks like a mood alongside 'blue', but blue here means smutty or indecent.
explanation.definitionFit: Blue jokes are indecent ones, so blue is a synonym for vulgar or improper.

clue.text: Dance cards?

definitions.meaning: a square dance for four couples
also the name of an old four-player card game

explanation.definitionFit: One word names both an old square dance for four couples and an eighteenth-century card game for four players.

clue.text: I'm buoyed up by years of vision

indicators.note: in a down clue, being buoyed up by something means sitting above it

parts.note: taken as written, without the apostrophe
an age is a long span of years

explanation.surface: Someone's spirits are lifted by years of having a dream.
explanation.definitionFit: A vision is a mental picture, a synonym of the idea seen in the mind's eye.

clue.text: Attribution of religious masterpiece: I set sin free

indicators.note: setting the letters free lets them fall into a new order

explanation.surface: A caption crediting a famous religious painting with freeing the faithful from sin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'free' signals an anagram of I SET SIN. The held text dropped the 'I'; the blog confirms the fodder. The ceiling frescoes are credited as the Sistine Chapel's.
explanation.definitionFit: Michelangelo's ceiling frescoes are identified by the chapel adjective naming their Vatican home.

clue.text: Play created in midst of implausible …

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other
midst of picks a run of letters from the middle of the word implausible

parts.note: created means made

explanation.surface: A drama was produced amid something hard to believe, continued in the next clue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'midst of' takes AUS from the middle of 'implausible', and 'in' puts MADE inside it. The ellipsis joins this clue to the next one for the surface only.
explanation.definitionFit: Peter Shaffer's stage drama about Mozart takes the composer's middle name as its title.

clue.text: Drive out slanted reporting

definitions.meaning: a short trip out in a car
news given a biased political slant

explanation.definitionFit: A brief pleasure trip in a car and a press officer's biased version of events share one word.

clue.text: … investigation of priest's habit

parts.note: P is a standard abbreviation for priest
a habit is a monk's robe

explanation.surface: An inquiry into a clergyman's outfit, continuing the previous clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A probe is a searching inquiry, a synonym for an official investigation.

clue.text: Gardener and house-husband?

definitions.meaning: someone who raises plants for sale
humorously, a man who works in the children's room

explanation.definitionFit: A grower of young plants is also, read whimsically, a man who minds the children's room at home.

clue.text: Glow with resentment following period on spelling

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed above the next piece
following places the resentment word after what comes before it

parts.note: per. is an abbreviation for period
ire is anger or resentment

explanation.surface: Someone flushes with annoyance after a lesson on spelling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Glow' is the genteel euphemism: horses sweat, men perspire, ladies glow.
explanation.definitionFit: Glowing is the polite euphemism for sweating, so it stands for breaking into a sweat.

clue.text: Measure front of auditorium in theatre …

parts.note: a dram is a small measure of spirits

indicators.note: front of takes the opening letter of auditorium

explanation.surface: Someone sizes up the front stalls of a playhouse.
explanation.definitionFit: Theatre as a genre or art form is a synonym for plays generally.

clue.text: … where "gods" are to become performers' entrance

indicators.note: to become says the letters change into something new

explanation.surface: In a playhouse, the cheap upper balcony seats are turned into the actors' way in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to become' signals an anagram of GODS ARE. The gods are the theatre's highest, cheapest seats.
explanation.definitionFit: Actors arrive by a side entry at the back of the theatre, away from the public foyer.

clue.text: Unpaid benefit from Father putting daughter in scary situation

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father as a priest's title

indicators.note: in puts the daughter letter inside the scary word

parts.note: eerie means creepy or scary

explanation.surface: A dad gets something for nothing by putting his daughter in a frightening spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting something without paying for it is a gratis gain, an advantage enjoyed at no cost.

clue.text: Sound diverted with soft material

indicators.note: Sound says the word for diverted is heard rather than written

parts.note: diverted means swayed, influenced away from a course

explanation.surface: A noise was redirected using soft fabric, as in muffling it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like a noun, but it is the homophone signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Leather with a napped, velvety finish is a soft material used for shoes and jackets.

clue.text: October 15's arrangement is extendable

indicators.note: arrangement says the letters are put into a new order

parts.note: the answer to 15 across

explanation.surface: Something about an October event is said to be stretchable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arrangement' signals an anagram of OCT plus ECLIPSE, the answer to 15 across.
explanation.definitionFit: Something extending in sliding sections, like a spyglass, is extendable.

clue.text: Movie extracts shown in midweek outshine …

indicators.note: shown in says the extracts are placed inside the midweek letters

parts.note: the middle letters of week
clips are short extracts from films

explanation.surface: Film clips shown on a Wednesday outdo everything, continuing into the next clue.
explanation.definitionFit: To eclipse someone is to overshadow them, a synonym of outshine.

clue.text: Prior to Conservative's utterance, spot of argument's capital

parts.note: pre- means before or prior to

indicators.note: utterance says the word is heard, so the spelling may differ

parts.note: a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party

indicators.note: spot of picks out the first letter of argument

explanation.surface: Before a Tory speaks, a little argument breaks out in the capital.
explanation.walkthrough: TORY spoken gives TORI. Then A comes from 'spot of argument'.
explanation.definitionFit: The city is South Africa's administrative seat of government, one of its three capitals.

clue.text: … dire spy concoction, being thin and sprawling

indicators.note: a concoction is a mixture made up, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A dreadful spy story, poorly written and rambling.
explanation.definitionFit: Spindly handwriting with long thin strokes looks like a spider's legs.

clue.text: Vanish with girl on pot and speed

parts.note: Eva is a girl's name
a po is a chamber pot
rate means speed

explanation.surface: A girl disappears with a chamber pot at speed.
explanation.walkthrough: PO is British slang for a chamber pot.
explanation.definitionFit: Liquid that turns to vapour disappears, so the word means to vanish.

clue.text: Sight missing in London with Turner gone?

definitions.meaning: the London Eye, the giant turning wheel, being taken away

explanation.walkthrough: The London Eye is the huge observation wheel on the Thames, the 'Turner' because it turns.
explanation.definitionFit: Blind means lacking sight, and London lacking its big wheel would be without its Eye.

clue.text: Bit of a toss-up, removing top man

indicators.note: bit of says the answer is a part of the following words

explanation.surface: Part of a coin toss decides who loses the boss's job.
explanation.definitionFit: A supremo is an overall leader or boss, the person in charge.

clue.text: His wife was swapped in Service supplied by ATS, printed at Trinity Mirror Print- ack issues available from His Austria th the Post Office Gibraltar Slovakia

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as OCR garble ('His wife was swapped in Service supplied by ATS, printed at Trinity Mirror...'); the blog says it is an anagram of EASTMAN, a word missing from the held text.
annotationWithheld.clue: His wife was swapped in Service supplied by ATS, printed at Trinity Mirror Print- ack issues available from His Austria th the Post Office Gibraltar Slovakia

clue.text: Alleviate tinkle in gun

indicators.note: in places the tinkle word inside the gun

parts.note: the Sten is a British submachine gun
a tinkle and wee are both childish words for urinating

explanation.surface: An absurd remedy: ease things by peeing in a gun.
explanation.walkthrough: In British slang 'tinkle' and 'wee' both mean to urinate.
explanation.definitionFit: To ease pain or soften a blow is to make it more pleasant, as sugar does.

clue.text: Feature nothing in cotton cloth

parts.note: the chin is a facial feature
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A face shows nothing, as if made of cotton.
explanation.definitionFit: Chino is a hard-wearing twilled cotton fabric used for trousers.

clue.text: Setter's agreement in principle

parts.note: the setter refers to themselves as I
a deal is an agreement

explanation.surface: The puzzle-setter agrees to something in principle.
explanation.definitionFit: An ideal is a standard of perfection or guiding principle one aims to live by.

clue.text: Where journalists collect squash and buffet

parts.note: to press is to squash
to box is to buffet with blows

explanation.surface: Reporters gather to squeeze around a buffet table.
explanation.definitionFit: Reporters sit together in a reserved area at a sports ground or court.

clue.text: As an example, football dispenses finally with alcohol

indicators.note: finally takes the closing letter of dispenses

parts.note: port is a fortified wine

explanation.surface: Football gives out drink at the end of a match.
explanation.definitionFit: Football is one example of an athletic game or pastime.

clue.text: Neglect is oddly feasible

indicators.note: oddly takes the odd-numbered letters of feasible

explanation.surface: Someone claims that leaving things undone is strangely possible.
explanation.definitionFit: To fail to do something is to neglect it, as in failing to warn someone.

clue.text: Chief mandates probe to fly round Iran's capital

indicators.note: round puts the letters around a single letter
to fly means the letters scatter into a new order
capital is the first letter of Iran

explanation.surface: A leader authorises a spy mission to fly around the Iranian capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to fly' signals an anagram of MANDATES PROBE, and 'round' puts it around I, the first letter of Iran.
explanation.definitionFit: A head of state is the nation's chief, here the then American leader.

clue.text: See 27
The c-word?

parts.note: a pun on the taboo phrase: the letter c stands for a temperature word on bath taps

explanation.definitionFit: On taps, C marks the chilly water, so this is the word the letter stands for.

clue.text: Sole rises, then, for poor?

parts.note: when the sole of a shoe lifts away, the heel part is lowered, a phrase for shabby poverty

explanation.definitionFit: Shoes with worn-down heels picture someone shabby and hard up.
